title: GameTrace
responsibility: Show the current game view checkpoint execution trace in a collapsible list.

inputs.name: GameTrace.run
inputs.description: The run whose `trace` array is the only run field this component reads, so only its entries determine the heading count and the rows; checkpointGraph keeps only the latest 1000 entries. An entry matches when its `viewId` equals `view.id`, and an entry whose `viewId` is null or undefined also matches, since it is treated as the current view.

trace.reason: x gte 4 AND hasKey eq true

inputs.name: GameTrace.view
inputs.description: The game view being previewed; the component reads only its `id`, to decide which trace entries match, and its `checkpoints`, to title each row from its `checkpointId`. A `checkpointId` that no checkpoint in `view.checkpoints` has is shown as the raw id, and the view's title, style, dimension, planning and world are not read.

examples.title: The courtyard
examples.style: Lush illustrated garden, warm stone, soft sunlight. Preserve the player, key and door positions.

checkpoints.title: Collect the key
checkpoints.description: When the player reaches the key, add it to inventory.

checkpoints.title: Unlock the door
checkpoints.description: The key unlocks the door. Reveal two possible destinations.

outputs.name: GameTrace
outputs.description: The markup of one `hx-details` element whose `hx-summary` reads `Execution trace (N)`, where N is the number of matching entries; it holds either an `hx-ol` with one `hx-li` per matching entry, in trace order (an `hx-strong` with the checkpoint title, or the raw checkpoint id if no checkpoint in the view has that id, followed by the entry's tick and reason), or, when N is 0, an `hx-p` reading 'No checkpoints have fired in this preview.' It is built only from the `run` and `view` props and declares no callbacks.
